rows.archetype: Relic-supported shivs with scaling defense and conditional Finale
rows.summary: Kin is next, with no preparation nodes remaining. Seek shiv scaling, efficient mitigation, then draw and retention. Replace Strikes before Defends. Finale is conditional, not guaranteed damage; the damage gap remains uncalibrated. Avoid elites until defense improves significantly—in later acts when possible, rather than risking the run for speculative rewards. This is especially important with no further preparation nodes before Kin and no calibrated damage gap to justify additional risk. Keep basic blocks until replacements are secured.

rows.archetype: Relic-supported shivs with scaling defense and conditional Finale
rows.summary: Shiv supply is sufficient; prioritize scaling, block and draw through two shops. Avoid optional elites. Refuel only when charges require it. Finale is conditional; damage gap and complete-core performance remain unknown.

rows.archetype: Relic-supported shivs seeking scaling and reliable defense
rows.summary: Keep the forced-elite route and later fires. Use Tent for healing and Neutralize smithing. Seek scaling, defense and boss potions before low-impact removals. Recheck Candle charges. Damage gap and complete-core performance remain unknown.

rows.archetype: Relic-supported shivs seeking scaling and sustained defense
rows.summary: Keep the safer question-mark route. Use Tent for healing and Footwork smithing. Seek shiv scaling, sustained defense and draw; selectively remove obsolete Strikes. Damage gap and complete-core performance remain unknown.

rows.archetype: Weak-amplified relic shivs with passive block and selective draw
rows.summary: Prioritize shiv scaling, repeatable Weak and efficient draw. Remove obsolete Strikes selectively. Follow one elite and three Tent fires; heal, smith and refuel. Preserve resources for consecutive bosses. Damage gap, dilution and complete-core performance remain unknown.
